summary: Backend + Frontend E2E validated for schedule overrides feature. 8/8 pytest cases pass. Playwright validated: login, both schedule sections rendered, calendar navigation to Sept 2026, create/delete override for 2026-09-16 (08:00), gold marker toggling, availability shift 10:00->08:00 (and back), Thursday 09-17 stays base 10:00, closed-day override yields empty slots with red marker, other tabs (Agenda/Servicios/Bloqueos/Clientes) load without crash. NOTE: bundle served initially was stale (still showed old 'Horario laboral' panel); had to `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` for the new SchedulePanel to take effect.
action_items: Consider auto-restarting frontend when SchedulePanel is rebuilt if webpack HMR ever gets stuck. Not blocking — one-time issue in this iteration resolved via supervisor restart.
critical_code_review_comments: ESLint warning in AdminDashboard.jsx line 104: useEffect missing dependency 'load'/'loadOverrides'. Cosmetic but worth fixing to avoid stale closures.
server.py _compute_slots: today gating uses server local time (datetime.now()) not Europe/Madrid TZ; acceptable per code comment but note if server tz drifts.
schedule_overrides collection has no pruning; user explicitly opted to keep past overrides as history — OK.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seeds; all created overrides for 2026-09-16/18/19 were deleted at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature stable. If UI shows old SchedulePanel again, restart frontend supervisor. Backend tests can be re-run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_schedule_overrides.py`.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. Only note: initial bundle served did not include new SchedulePanel changes; root cause was webpack hot-reload not updating served bundle. Fixed by `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`.
